data.name: YouPro
data.subtitle: Feature-rich YouTube tweak by alibusut
data.localizedDescription: YouPro is a YouTube modification tweak developed by alibusut. This community-distributed YouProEXTRA build includes additional player tweaks and controls. Features and bundled tweaks vary by release; the current publisher notes that downloads may work only partially and standalone iSponsorBlock is not included.
data.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.43.5 | YouProExtra_21.43.5_1.3.1

### Latest Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE]
> - **YTUHD** is not included. 4K60HDR is available.
> - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. 
> - no iSponsorBlock and YouSlider. (unstable in newer builds)
> - Downloads working partially. depending on hardware codecs. 
> - Liquid Glass Support
> 
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` 

> [!WARNING]
> - 21.34.3+ builds require iOS 17+ now.

compatibility.notes: YouPro is developed by alibusut; mrdrvt99/YouProEXTRA distributes this community IPA. The currently listed releases require iOS 17.0 or later according to the distributor's source. Shares com.google.ios.youtube with the other YouTube mods: install one at a time.
